en: A legal agreement in which you pay to use a building or land for a period; or to rent something to someone.
ex: We signed a two-year lease on the apartment.
我們簽了這間公寓為期兩年的租約。

en: To produce a copy of something; or to have young animals or plants.
ex: Scientists could not reproduce the results of the experiment.
科學家無法重現這個實驗的結果。

en: A large mass of ice that moves slowly down a mountain valley.
ex: The glacier is retreating because of global warming.
因為全球暖化，這座冰川正在退縮。

en: A light, silver-colored metal used to make cans, foil and airplane parts.
ex: Soft drink cans are usually made of aluminum.
汽水罐通常是用鋁製成的。

en: A newspaper article that gives the opinion of the editor; or relating to the work of editors.
ex: The newspaper's editorial criticized the new policy.
該報的社論批評了這項新政策。

en: A small musical instrument that you hold to your mouth and blow or suck to play.
ex: He played a sad tune on the harmonica.
他用口琴吹奏了一首悲傷的曲調。

en: The art of managing relations between countries; or skill in dealing with people without upsetting them.
ex: The crisis was solved through patient diplomacy.
這場危機透過耐心的外交斡旋得到解決。

en: Relating to an empire or emperor; or using the measurement units of Britain (yards, pounds).
ex: Tourists visit the imperial palace every day.
遊客每天都來參觀皇宮。

en: To prevent something bad from happening; or to turn your eyes away from something.
ex: Quick action helped avert a major disaster.
迅速的行動幫助避免了一場重大災難。

en: To call people together for a formal meeting; or to come together for such a meeting.
ex: The committee will convene next Monday to discuss the budget.
委員會將在下週一召開會議討論預算。

en: To separate something from something else it is fixed to.
ex: Carefully detach the form along the dotted line.
請沿虛線小心撕下表格。

en: A new interest in or growth of something that had become less popular or active.
ex: The town has seen a revival of interest in traditional crafts.
這座城鎮對傳統工藝的興趣重新興起。

en: Including everything or everyone; or including all costs in the price.
ex: The price is inclusive of all taxes and fees.
價格已含所有稅金和費用。

en: The ability to read and write; or knowledge of a particular subject.
ex: The government launched a campaign to improve literacy.
政府發起了提升識字率的運動。

en: A small, thin piece torn or cut from something; or to cut or tear into small pieces.
ex: He shredded the old documents before throwing them away.
他在丟棄舊文件之前把它們絞碎。

en: The ability of soil to grow crops well; or the ability to have children.
ex: The river valley is known for the fertility of its soil.
這個河谷以土壤肥沃聞名。

en: A small piece of metal or cloth with a design or words that shows a person's rank, job or membership.
ex: The officer showed his badge to the guard.
警官向警衛出示了他的警徽。

en: Careful to do things properly and well; guided by your conscience.
ex: She is a conscientious student who always does her homework.
她是個認真的學生，總是做功課。

en: To prevent something from happening or developing easily; or a large basket with a lid.
ex: Bad weather hampered the rescue efforts.
惡劣天氣阻礙了救援行動。

en: Having doubts about whether something is true or useful.
ex: Many scientists are skeptical about the claim.
許多科學家對這個說法持懷疑態度。

en: To live in a place, usually used for animals or groups of people.
ex: Many rare birds inhabit the wetlands.
許多珍稀鳥類棲息在濕地裡。

en: A strong alcoholic drink made from grain, especially made in Scotland or Ireland.
ex: He poured himself a glass of whisky.
他給自己倒了一杯威士忌。

en: The government department in charge of a country's money; or a place where valuable things are stored.
ex: The Treasury announced new tax measures today.
財政部今天宣布了新的稅務措施。

en: A very large quantity of something; more than enough.
ex: The region has an abundance of natural resources.
該地區擁有豐富的天然資源。

en: To make a word or phrase shorter by leaving out letters.
ex: The word "doctor" is often abbreviated to "Dr."
「doctor」一詞常縮寫為「Dr.」。

en: A king or queen; or having supreme power and not controlled by any other country.
ex: The country became a sovereign state in 1960.
該國於1960年成為主權國家。

en: A current of cold air in a room; or a drawing or design; also (British) a draft beer.
ex: Close the window; there's a cold draught in here.
把窗戶關上，這裡有冷風。

en: Legally responsible for something; or likely to do something.
ex: The company is liable for any damage caused by its products.
公司須對其產品造成的任何損害負責。

en: Very brave, especially in a way that people admire; or relating to heroes.
ex: The firefighter's heroic act saved three lives.
那位消防員的英勇行為救了三條人命。

en: Something added to something else to complete or improve it; or an extra section added to a book or newspaper.
ex: She takes a vitamin supplement every morning.
她每天早上服用維他命補充劑。

en: To remove a cover from something to show it for the first time; or to reveal new plans or a product publicly.
ex: The company will unveil its new smartphone next week.
公司將於下週發表新款智慧型手機。

en: A story published or broadcast in several parts; or happening in a series one after another.
ex: The novel was first published as a serial in a magazine.
這部小說最初是在雜誌上連載發表的。

en: Skilled work done by hand to make decorative objects; or the objects made this way.
ex: The village is famous for its handicrafts.
這座村莊以手工藝品聞名。

en: Having moods that change quickly, often becoming sad or angry for no clear reason.
ex: He's been moody all week and won't talk to anyone.
他整週都悶悶不樂，誰也不理。

en: A group of countries or states that are joined together by common interests; or a state or republic.
ex: Canada and Australia are members of the Commonwealth.
加拿大和澳洲是大英國協的成員。

en: A high-ranking priest in the Catholic Church; or a small red bird; or most important.
ex: The cardinal officiated at the ceremony.
紅衣主教主持了典禮。

en: Crushed oats cooked with milk or water, eaten as a breakfast food.
ex: He eats a bowl of oatmeal with fruit every morning.
他每天早上吃一碗加水果的燕麥粥。

en: The force that slows down things that rub together; or disagreement between people.
ex: There has been friction between the two departments.
這兩個部門之間一直有摩擦。

en: A formal promise, especially one made in a court or to God; or a swear word.
ex: The witness took an oath to tell the truth.
證人宣誓要說實話。

en: Frightening or difficult to deal with because of size, power or difficulty; very impressive.
ex: The team faced a formidable opponent in the finals.
球隊在決賽中面對了一個強大的對手。
